title: mlx-omarchy community submission payload, schema v1/v2
description: The JSON summary the collector sends alongside the chunked archive. The Worker validates this strictly; unknown fields are rejected. Covers the quick/deep collector kinds; the e2e kind has payload-v1-e2e.schema.json. schema_version 2 (2026-10) adds the ane_macos/ane_linux turn-on blocks and the omarchy_ane promotion block; v1 rows stay valid and accepted.

mailbox.description: The ANE mailbox node(s) (the mboxes target): full devicetree props (reg window, interrupts, status). The send-empty line pick on stock apple-mailbox SoCs needs the reg and the AIC line.

reserved_memory.description: The devicetree reserved-memory subtree: found/child_count plus the (ane-named) children with reg, iommu-addresses, compatible. found=false with child_count=0 is a platform fact, not a probe failure.

dtb_sha256_error.description: Why dtb_sha256 is null: /sys/firmware/fdt is root-only on shipped kernels, so almost every Linux row records 'needs root'. The collector never calls sudo itself.

set_base_candidate.description: HYPOTHESIS, never a derived fact: ANE SET region candidate = pmgr block base + 0xc000 (where the T8103/T6001 ane_* pwrstate cluster lives and where m1n1 ps_map points). driver_window_confirms records whether Apple's own ane device reg grants a window at exactly that address, which corroborates the hypothesis (t6021: ane0 reg range 3). Linux/m1n1 enumerates the cluster itself. Open to collector extension fields since 2026-09-19 (issue #8): unknown keys pass through; declared keys keep their type/length caps.

adt.description: Apple Device Tree artifact discovery on Linux (m1n1 stage2 / distro ADT dump / live FDT). Presence + sha256 only; the artifact bytes stay on the machine and the hash pins which tree a capture explains. found=false with source=null means no candidate artifact exists.

adt_nodes.description: ANE-relevant nodes decoded from the ADT artifact: the authoritative path for engine base + DART stream-IDs on any SoC (macOS IORegistry does not expose the engine sub-window). null until the ADT decode step emits it.

firmware.description: ANE firmware placement: names, sizes, sha256 of matched files under the known firmware roots; the bytes never leave the machine.

omarchy_ane.description: The omarchy-ane turn-on block (deep rows; contract field names read by omarchy-ane promotion tooling - do not rename): install ids, check state, bound module, firmware hashes, opt-in keys, opt-in smoke, uptime, filtered kernel log with the fault subset. Own cap 48 KiB; when over cap the dmesg tail is dropped first and check/module/smoke/dmesg_faults are never dropped.

machine_id.description: First 16 hex of sha256 of a random per-install token (~/.config/mlx-omarchy/machine-id, mode 0600). Never a serial/UUID/MAC.

owner_id.description: Same shape as machine_id from its own token; the owner may copy owner-id to their other machines to link their submissions.

smoke.description: Opt-in parakeet-encoder smoke (only with the collector's consent flag, omarchy-ane installed and the module bound). Until the packaged runner ships: available=false with the reason, never omitted.

golden_sha256.description: The pinned golden hash the packaged add fixture must match; pinned by omarchy-ane, echoed by the runner. The whole-encoder hash stays a developer-side golden, never a collector field.

interrupts.description: ANE/DART/mailbox lines of /proc/interrupts: idle pair 10 s apart, third sample after the opt-in smoke when it ran (a storm shows as rate between the samples).

IOInterruptSpecifiers.description: Hex, one entry per specifier (canonical since schema v2: ["0x74030000"]). Published v1 rows carry three legacy encodings (python bytes repr, latin-1 text, U+FFFD-lossy); readers must accept all four.

children.description: IORegistry children of this node with their reg entries, when the registry exposes them. t6021 mining showed macOS exposes NO ane0 engine sub-window; an empty/null capture is a platform fact, not a probe failure.

iommu_cells.description: Devicetree-only property; always null on macOS (see truncated marker iommu_cells:unavailable_on_macos).

dart_options.description: Raw dart-options IORegistry property when present; dart-internal ID, NOT a stream map (t6021: 0x25-class values). Recorded for completeness.

mailbox_nodes.description: The ANE mailbox nodes from the IOService plane: reg window, AIC interrupt line (hex), phandle.

dt_nodes.description: IODeviceTree-plane nodes matching the ANE family (ane / dart-ane / iop-ane / ascwrap / exclave / t8020 patterns, so M3-M6 generations are captured without code changes). WHITELIST keys only: name, compatible, reg, interrupts, interrupt-names, IOInterruptSpecifiers, segment-ranges, ane-type/subtype/id, die-id, die-ane-id, clock-gates, power-gates, iommu-parent, phandle, vm-base, vm-size, page-size, sids, bypass-15, instance, dapf-instance-0, dart-id, dart-options, role, device_type, ranges, #address-cells, #size-cells. Binary values as hex. Root and /chosen are never dumped.

interrupt_controllers.description: Interrupt-controller table for decoding device IOInterruptSpecifiers (AIC phandle -> cells). IORegistry rarely surfaces #interrupt-cells; null is a platform miss, not a probe failure.

reg_ranges_total.description: True range count; null when the range cap dropped any (truncated marker reg_ranges:<name>:<total>).

soc_id.description: platform-name OSData decoded to ASCII, e.g. t6021.

binaries_cache_resident.description: Framework/kext binaries live in the dyld shared cache / boot kernel collection; on-disk bundles are plist-only stubs. Known condition, not a failure.

set_base_candidate.description: HYPOTHESIS, never a derived fact: ANE SET region candidate = pmgr block base + 0xc000 (where the T8103/T6001 ane_* pwrstate cluster lives and where m1n1 ps_map points). driver_window_confirms records whether Apple's own ane device reg grants a window at exactly that address, which corroborates the hypothesis (t6021: ane0 reg range 3). Linux/m1n1 enumerates the cluster itself. Open to collector extension fields since 2026-09-19 (issue #8): unknown keys pass through; declared keys keep their type/length caps.

ane_macos.description: Deep macOS ANE turn-on block (schema v2). Pattern-based M3-M6 discovery: every IODeviceTree node whose name/compatible/device_type/role matches the ANE family, with ALL properties (strip list applied), ANE driver classes, loaded ANE kexts, OS firmware image hashes (names/sizes/sha256 of public paths only, never the files), and the opt-in CoreML smoke. Bulk raw fields also live in the archive; the payload block is budget-capped and records what was dropped.

generation_probe.description: Per-pattern hit counts; a pattern with no match is {matched: 0}, never omitted.

stripped.description: Names (never values) of the identity properties the strip list removed.

ane_linux.description: Deep Linux ANE turn-on block (schema v2): generation probe over the booted devicetree, full reserved-memory subtree, /proc/interrupts samples, package versions, host facts, and the dtc-text dump state. The promotion-critical omarchy_ane block rides ane_port_detail.runtime.omarchy_ane.

boot_id.description: sha256 of the boot id, truncated to 12 hex.
